cycles.title: High-treewidth local twins and length normalization
cycles.result: H116 was rejected for a circuit-length parameter mismatch. The low-treewidth XOR-cycle twins were upgraded to explicit high-treewidth toroidal Tseitin twins, leaving one common-quotient factorization theorem as the restricted-locality gate.
cycles.claim_boundary: C018 does not prove the quotient theorem, a SAT circuit lower bound, or P != NP.
